claims.text: Sprint 14's backlog in docs/team/sprint-example.md has an Ước lượng column with 3 (cancel endpoint), 3 (cancel button), 2, 2 and 1 (wrong-total fix); the table gives no hours.
The retrospective's action for the next sprint is that every item larger than 3 points (điểm) must have two people read its code.
The Scrum Guide 2020 says the Developers who will be doing the work are responsible for sizing, and prescribes no estimation technique; story points are not part of the Guide.

A story point estimates size relative to the team's other stories, not hours; a 3-point story is expected to take about three times the effort of a 1-point one; points are specific to one team's scale.
Comparing a story with known ones is usually easier and more consistent than predicting its duration in hours.
